## Facts and statements

- [statement] Time to First Token (TTFT) is compute-bound, determined by prompt batch parallel FLOPs on GPU compute cores, whereas auto-regressive token generation (TPS) is memory bandwidth-bound. (high confidence) — https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm · keywords: Inference Metrics Framework: TTFT TPS and Memory Profiling · also: https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx/blob/main/docs/src/usage/benchmarks.rst
- [statement] Measuring peak VRAM consumption requires tracking resident set size (RSS), active Metal wired memory allocations, and discrete GPU allocated VRAM during maximum prompt length ingestion. (high confidence) — https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx/blob/main/docs/src/usage/benchmarks.rst · keywords: Inference Metrics Framework: TTFT TPS and Memory Profiling · also: https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp/tree/master/examples/benchmark
- [statement] Reporting mean tokens per second without measuring inter-token latency variance masks stutter caused by periodic garbage collection, dynamic KV cache reallocation, and memory compaction. (high confidence) — https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm · keywords: Inference Metrics Framework: TTFT TPS and Memory Profiling · also: https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp/tree/master/examples/benchmark
- [statement] Automated evaluation pipelines must record thermal throttling states and host bus bandwidth saturation alongside inference latency to ensure benchmark reproducibility. (high confidence) — https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm · keywords: Inference Metrics Framework: TTFT TPS and Memory Profiling · also: https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx/blob/main/docs/src/usage/benchmarks.rst
